answer_1.quote: we examine the generalizability of POSPD by applying it to two widely-used NAG models (i.e., CMLM and DisCo) over four text generation tasks, including text summarization, story ending generation, question generation, and machine translation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs for text summarization, story ending generation, question generation, and machine translation.

answer_2.quote: Follow GLGE , we use ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2), and ROUGE-L (R-L) as evaluation metrics for text summarization, while BLEU-4 (B-4), Meteor (Denkowski and Lavie, 2014), and R-L are used in question generation and story ending generation. Meanwhile, BLEU-4 is also the evaluation metric for machine translation to keep in line with previous works .
